  • Method Details

    • actions

      @NonNull public FaceLivenessConfig.Builder actions(@NonNull java.util.List<FaceAction> value)
      Set ordered actions before passive liveness. Repeated actions are allowed, with at most four steps. An empty list means passive liveness only.

    • actionTimeoutMillis

      @NonNull public FaceLivenessConfig.Builder actionTimeoutMillis(long value)
      Set the time allowance per action, at least 2000 ms. The overall action-sequence limit is this value multiplied by the action count.

    • faceAcquisitionTimeoutMillis

      @NonNull public FaceLivenessConfig.Builder faceAcquisitionTimeoutMillis(long value)
      Set the maximum wait for the first eligible face, 1000..60000 ms.

    • allowMultipleFaces

      @NonNull public FaceLivenessConfig.Builder allowMultipleFaces(boolean allowed)
      Whether other faces may appear at the same time. Default false. Enabling this does not guarantee identity continuity across frames.
